original_text: How to swear in French. Putain ! Oh putain ! Merde ! Merde, j'ai oublié les clés. Connard ! Connard, tu sais pas conduire ! Oh la la la la, t'es vraiment chiant !
translated_text: How to swear in French. Damn! Oh damn! Shit ! Shit, I forgot the keys. Asshole! Asshole, you don't know how to drive! Oh la la la la, you're really annoying!
